name: Bobnice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a yellow fly half and a red hoist half, separated by a diagonal band of white over black.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 25 March 2005 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
